informatique.name: La salle des ordinateurs · The Computer Room
informatique.alt: A bright, modern computer lab with smooth white walls, code and circuit posters and a black pendant lamp. On the left a closed wooden door; a tutor raises one finger as she teaches two students working on laptops at a round table; a boy in a yellow sweater throws up his hands, sorry, as the computer mouse he knocked off dangles by its cord just above the floor; a girl crouches to take a book from a low bookshelf. In the middle the glass front doors stand open onto stone steps and green trees. On the right a boy holds up a long printout that spills to the floor beside a desk with a slim computer and a big screen showing a glowing globe wrapped in a net of lines; a tall black server rack blinks with blue and green lights next to a digital keypad on the wall; a technician kneels to tie a tangle of blue cables, and a researcher in a white coat shares her notebook with a colleague at the big window beneath a wood-and-steel staircase.

doors.label: le coin pause
doors.hint: Go through the wooden door to the break corner

doors.label: l'étage
doors.hint: Go up the stairs to the upstairs lab

etage.name: L'étage · The Upstairs Lab
etage.alt: The attic computer lab upstairs. On the left the staircase comes up beside a window with a big white satellite dish on the roof outside; a boy steers a flight simulator in front of a curved screen of clouds; a girl drops crumpled paper into a wicker bin; two girls kneel on the floor plugging two cables together. On the right a man in a grey suit ticks a checklist on his clipboard beside a very large monitor; a little brass clockwork robot walks on the desk; a man plays the keyboard like a piano; a man in a safari hat looks through binoculars at a screen of giraffes; and in front a man sits in his boss's leather chair holding a signed paper with a red seal.

doors.label: la salle des ordinateurs
doors.hint: Go back down the stairs to the computer room

pause.name: Le coin pause · The Break Corner
pause.alt: A cosy break corner with a tall window onto green trees and a potted plant. On the left a wooden door; a girl points inside an open computer case to show her friend the circuit board; a young woman on a bench raises her palm for a break beside her sandwich; on a green sofa a girl comforts her sad friend holding a games controller. On the right a man at his laptop tosses a paper airplane, a man breaks the red wax seal on a boxed software package, and a cheerful IT specialist in a magician's top hat waves a wand at an open computer, his toolbag at his feet.

doors.label: la salle des ordinateurs
doors.hint: Go back through the wooden door to the computer room
